description_en: Tis rest house was built along with a stone water tank (jaḥdhuṃ) and a well at the premises during the Rāṇā period, commissioned by a Khatrī family.Since the Phalcā is located at a place called Bavāḥpau, it is named Bavāḥpau Phalcā for the purpose of this documentation. It seems to have been built next to a small pathway along what once used to be a large stretch of agricultural land, in order to facilitate farmers and passersby to rest and quench their thirst. In 1888 CE (VS 1945), Narmadādevī and her sons commmissioned the Phalcā along with a water tank (jaḥdhuṃ) and a well as its source of water near their residence. This is said to have been the request of her husband Pratimāna Khatrī (text: Ṣatri), who passed away before the construction was ended. An inscription in the Phalcā recording the event of construction also instructs a person named Suratha Daṅgola from Theco to observe the anniversary of the building from the income from the land endowment made by the Khatrī family. The three-bayed Phalcā used to stand next to a street. However, when a private trust (guthi) run by the descendants of Pratimāna Khatrī rebuilt thesitein 2022 CE (VS 2079), it was shifted a few meters to the west. The private trust observes the anniversary of thephalcāevery year on the 3rd of the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha (local resident, KC, age 48). Today, the building is fenced in, as well as the jhadum. the fields have disappeared and the phalca now rests next to a small leisure pavillion, and a badminton court.
description_ne: राणाकालमा एक खत्री परिवारले बटुवालाई लक्षित गरी फल्चासंगै एकैसाथ चौबीसै घण्टा पानी खान मिल्ने गरी ढुङ्गे भाडो (जःधुं) र स्रोतको रूपमा इनार समेत निर्माण गरेका हुन् ।खेतमा काम गर्ने खेतालु, बटुवा, तीर्थालु आदिलाई बस्तीविहीन ठाउँमा खासगरी ओत लाग्न फल्चा, प्यास मेट्न जःधुं र जःधुंको लागि स्रोतका रूपमा कुवा वा इनारको पनि व्यवस्था हुनेगरी बनाइएका फल्चाहरू उपत्यकाका विभिन्न ठाउँमा पाइन्छन् । यो फल्चा पनि बवाःपौ भनिने कृषिक्षेत्रमा पर्ने बाटो किनारमा यसै हेतुबाट निर्मित फल्चा हो । फल्चामा भएको अभिलेख अनुसार फल्चा निर्मित स्थानबाट नजिकै घर भएका  प्रतिमान षत्रि (खत्री) ले विसं १९४४ (सन् १८८७-८८) मा यो कीर्ति निर्माण गर्ने संकल्प गरेको र उनको इच्छापूर्ति हुनुपूर्व नै उनको देहावसान भएकाले विसं १९४५ (सन् १८८८) मा उनका मुख्यानी नर्मदादेवी र छोराहरू गुमान्सिं, माथवरसिं, घवोजमानसिं मिली यस फल्चाका साथै जःधुं र इनार निर्माण गरेको प्रसंग उल्लेख छ । फल्चाको वार्षिकी र मर्मत गर्न जग्गा गुठी राखिएको र ठेचोका सुरथ डंङ्गोल मार्फत् वर्षको एकपल्ट भोजको आयोजना गराउन निर्देशन दिइएको छ । तीन कवलको फल्चा सडक किनारामै हुने गर्दथ्यो । विसं २०७९ (सन् २०२२) मा फल्चा यथास्थानबाट हटाई केही मीटर पश्चिमतिर सारी पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो । फल्चासंग सम्बन्धित प्रतिमानकै दरसन्तानहरूबाट संचालित निजी गुठीले यो कार्य गरेका थिए । यस गुठीले प्रतिवर्ष अक्षय तृतीया (वैशाख शुक्ल तृतीया) का दिन वार्षिकी मनाउँदै आएको छ । सो गुठीले फल्चा अगाडि होम गर्ने, सखरपानी बाँड्ने र गुठी खलक बसी भोज खाने चलन चलाउँदै आएका छन् (local resident, KC, age 48) ।

historical_events.event_description: Narmadādevī and her sons Gumānsiṃ, Māthavarasiṃ, and Ghavojamānasiṃ built the Phalcā near their residence as per the wish of her husband Pratimāna Khatrī (text: Ṣatri), who passed away before fulfilling his wish. They also built ajaḥdhuṃtank and a well to supply water to the tank at the premises. An inscription at the Phalcā recording the event also instructs a person named Suratha Daṅgola from Theco to observe the anniversary of thephalcāout of the income from the land endowment made by the Khatrī family.

The private trust (guthi) run by the descendants of Pratimāna Khatrī reconstructed the Phalcā. Initially, the three-bayrest house used to stand by fields and a small street. However, when the trust reconstructed it, it was shifted a few meters to the west.
